Hexed

Version

12.20.8834
July 29, 2019
Summer Update 2019

Status

Active
Hexed is a Special Condition where your character will be weakened. There are 3 different levels of Hex:
  • Lesser Hex: healing received is reduced (50%?).
  • Intense Hex: healing received is reduced (50%?) and deals less damage (50%?).
  • Greater Hex: healing received is reduced (50%?), deals less damage (50%?) and has reduced hit points (40% of maximum hitpoints).

How to get Hexed

This condition can be applied by certain bosses or boss fights:

  • Sir Baeloc and Sir Nictros (Grave Danger Quest) apply Lesser Hex. This effect cannot be removed.
  • Condensed Sin in the Lord Azaram fight (Grave Danger Quest) applies Lesser Hex. This effect cannot be removed.
  • The Monster (The Cradle of Monsters Quest) applies Lesser Hex. This effect cannot be removed.
  • King Zelos (Grave Danger Quest) applies Greater Hex with his beam attack. This Hex can be removed using the boss-fight mechanics but it's usually safer to wait for it to pass.
  • Upon entering The Pale Worm's room (Feaster of Souls Quest), all characters receive Greater Hex. This effect can be removed using a Soulforged Lantern and once it's removed it won't be applied again during the fight.
  • The battle against Ichgahal has mechanics that can apply all stages of Hex on characters.
  • Sugar Daddy in Candia also afflicts this condition if you fail to kill his minions within 15 seconds.

Additionally, some creatures can hex:

  • Devoted Radiant Acolyte and Devoted Radiant Zealot apply either Lesser Hex or Intense Hex. Can be removed with Cleanse.

How to remove Hex

As of the balancing changes on August 25, 2026, Cleanse Charm is now able to remove the Hex effect and grant the corresponding immunity.

Hex can sometimes be removed in boss fights by performing certain mechanics, as detailed above.
